results.title: Bilingualism is Associated with Executive Function in Children With Autism Spect
results.reason: The paper focuses on children with autism spectrum disorder, which falls under the exclusion criterion of being focused on children/adolescents/infants unless there are direct adult clinical implications. While executive function is relevant to clinical psychology, the specific population being studied (children) makes this paper less directly applicable to practicing clinicians who primarily work with adult populations.

results.title: Associations Between Sensory Changes and Psychological Problems After Moderate-t
results.reason: The study examines sensory changes and psychological problems after moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury (msTBI), which has direct clinical relevance for neuropsychology and rehabilitation psychology. The research addresses assessment and intervention implications for individuals experiencing these complex post-injury symptoms.
results.authors: Jai Carmichael; Marilien Claire Marzolla; Gershon Spitz; Kate Rachel Gould; Caroline van Heugten; Jennie Ponsford

results.title: Transdiagnostic Predictors of Job Tenure in People Living with Mental Disorders:
results.reason: This scoping review directly addresses clinical psychology practice by examining predictors of job tenure in people with mental disorders from a transdiagnostic perspective, which has significant implications for vocational rehabilitation and employment support services.
